$comment: The footer of the public export (krizaka-internal#4636, the pattern of verikora#914): grouped columns of the pages the export holds, then the legal line, no version. Words are message keys; a link names a page of lib/site.ts (`page`) or one of the site's addresses (`site`), never a typed URL. A page link the export does not hold is not drawn. Read by lib/public-footer.ts.
